name: VC Deal Flow Signal, Skills Manifest
description: Stable manifest of agent-callable skills exposed by this site. Each skill maps to an MCP prompt with a fully-specified invoke contract (transport + method + params), an optional REST httpAnalog for non-MCP agents, declared rate limits, and explicit free/paid cost. A fresh agent can enumerate every skill in one fetch without parsing the full OpenAPI document.
citation: VC Deal Flow Signal (signals.gitdealflow.com), Q2 2026 data. SSRN: 6606558.

item.name: Monday Signal Digest
item.title: Monday Signal Digest
item.description: Compose a Monday-morning intel brief from the current top-20 trending startups: each entry includes commit-velocity change, signal classification, and a one-line investor takeaway.

item.name: Sector Deep Dive
item.title: Sector Deep Dive
item.description: Sector intelligence brief, top movers, dark horses, and thesis follow-ups for a single named sector. Grounded in live signal data plus the SSRN methodology paper.

arguments.name: sector
arguments.description: Sector slug (e.g. 'devtools', 'ai-infrastructure', 'fintech', 'climate'). See /api/v1/signals.json sectors[].slug for the full list.

item.name: Find a Dark Horse
item.title: Find a Dark Horse
item.description: Surface one under-the-radar startup with sustained engineering acceleration but low public visibility. Optionally constrained to a sector.

arguments.name: sector
arguments.description: Optional sector slug to constrain the search.

item.name: Head-to-Head Compare
item.title: Head-to-Head Compare
item.description: Investor-grade comparison of two named startups across velocity, contributor growth, signal type, stage, and geography. Output is a markdown table plus a one-paragraph thesis differential.

arguments.name: name_a
arguments.description: First startup display name or GitHub org slug.

arguments.name: name_b
arguments.description: Second startup display name or GitHub org slug.

item.name: Company Diligence Dossier
item.title: Company Diligence Dossier
item.description: One cited, public-source dossier for a company or entity: who acquired it (M&A history), which funds publicly backed it, and its published engineering-acceleration signal. Mid-diligence grounding for 'who acquired X', 'which funds backed Y', 'what's the signal on Z'. Returns found:false with an honest note when the entity is outside the tracked corpus, never guesses.

arguments.name: company
arguments.description: Company or entity name (target, acquirer, or tracked startup). Examples: 'Figma', 'Supabase', 'Broadcom', 'Auth0'.

item.name: Acceleration Deal Memo
item.title: Acceleration Deal Memo
item.description: One-page deal memo for a named startup: composite Scout Score, sector percentile, plain-English thesis, three comparables, and a recommended next action. Grounded in the live deep-signal profile.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Startup display name or GitHub org slug.
